text: Every equipment item shall be tagged with the KKS number of the project equipment register (VGB-S-811 and the project key list) on a stainless steel nameplate (316L, 1 mm minimum) fixed with stainless rivets or screws. The nameplate shall show: KKS tag, manufacturer, type and serial number, year of manufacture, design conditions, weight, and the CE / PED mark where applicable.
